_about: English for src/data/vuln-howto.json, key by key: steps and links follow the Korean list item by item (steps give the text only; commands come from the Korean file). Menu labels are the ones on the English support pages.

_default.label: Other products
_default.who: People and companies using the product named in the article
steps: First check whether you use the product named in the article.
Find the fixed version in the vendor's official security notice and update. Vulnerabilities known in Korea are also posted on KISA's KrCERT security notices.

ms-office.label: MS Office
ms-office.who: Windows PCs running Microsoft 365 or Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
steps: Open an Office app (Word, for example) and go to File > Account. In classic Outlook it is File > Office Account.
Under Product Information, select Update Options > Update Now.

hancom.label: Hancom Office
hancom.who: PCs running Hancom Office (Hangul, Hancell, Hanshow)
steps: Download the patch for your version (Hancom Office 2024, for example) from the Hancom download center and install it.
Subscription (ESD), Hancom Docs and trial editions get patches through automatic updates.

windows.label: Windows
windows.who: People and companies using Windows PCs
steps: Windows 11: Start > Settings > Windows Update > Check for Windows updates
Windows 10: Start > Settings > Update & Security > Windows Update > Check for Windows updates
If updates are listed, select Download & install, and restart the PC when asked.

chrome.label: Chrome
chrome.who: People using the Chrome browser on a computer
steps: In Chrome, at the top right, select More (⋮) > Help > About Google Chrome.
Select Relaunch to apply the update. If there is no Relaunch button, Chrome is already up to date.

edge.label: Edge
edge.who: PCs using the Microsoft Edge browser
steps: Type edge://settings/help in the address bar. It also opens from Settings and more (…) > Help and feedback > About Microsoft Edge.
If an update is available, select Download and install; if it is already downloaded, select Restart.
links: Microsoft Support: Microsoft Edge update settings

iphone.label: iPhone & iPad
steps: Go to Settings > General > Software Update.
If an update is available, download and install it and follow the on-screen steps.
links: Apple Support: Update your iPhone or iPad

mac.label: Mac
steps: Go to Apple menu > System Settings > General > Software Update.
If an update is available, install it.
links: Apple Support: Update macOS on Mac

galaxy.label: Galaxy
galaxy.who: Samsung Galaxy phone and tablet users
steps: Go to Settings > Software update > Download and install.
If an update is available, download and install it, then restart when asked. Menu names can differ by model and software version.
links: Samsung Electronics Service: Galaxy software update (Korean)

android.label: Android
steps: Go to Settings > System > Software update and follow the on-screen steps.
In Settings > About phone > Android version, check the dates of the Android security update and the Google Play system update.
links: Android Help: Check and update your Android version

router.label: Router
steps: Open the router's admin page. For ipTIME the default address is 192.168.0.1.
In the firmware upgrade menu, upgrade if newer firmware is listed. Do not switch the router off while it upgrades.
For other brands, look up the latest firmware for your model on the maker's download page.

nginx.label: nginx
nginx.who: Servers running websites, reverse proxies or load balancers on nginx
steps: Check the installed version
Ubuntu, Debian
RHEL, Rocky, Alma, Amazon Linux
Test the configuration and restart
nginx.note: Distribution packages often carry fixes under an older version number. Do not go by the version number alone: check the distribution's security notice to see whether your package has the fix.

apache-httpd.label: Apache httpd
apache-httpd.who: Servers running websites on Apache HTTP Server (httpd)
steps: Check the installed version
Ubuntu, Debian
RHEL, Rocky, Alma
apache-httpd.note: Distribution packages often carry fixes under an older version number. Do not go by the version number alone: check the distribution's security notice to see whether your package has the fix.

openssl.label: OpenSSL
openssl.who: Servers and programs that use OpenSSL (most Linux web servers)
steps: Check the installed version
Ubuntu, Debian
RHEL, Rocky, Alma
After updating, restart the services that use OpenSSL (web servers and others) so they load the new library.
openssl.note: Distribution packages often carry fixes under an older version number. Check the distribution's security notice to see whether your package has the fix.

java.label: Java
java.who: Servers and business software running on Java (JDK, JRE), and PCs with Java installed
steps: Check the installed version
Ubuntu, Debian
RHEL, Rocky, Alma
Windows PC: Java Control Panel > Update tab > Update Now
Java bundled inside a product is updated by that product's vendor. Check the notices of the vendors of the software you run.

wordpress.label: WordPress
wordpress.who: People and companies running WordPress websites
steps: In the admin area, go to Dashboard > Updates and select Update Now.
Apply the plugin and theme updates on the same screen. If you use the plugin named in the article, check it first.

php.label: PHP
php.who: Servers running PHP websites (WordPress and others)
steps: Check the installed version
Ubuntu, Debian
RHEL, Rocky, Alma
After updating, restart the web server or PHP-FPM.

openssh.label: OpenSSH
openssh.who: Linux and Unix servers that accept remote SSH logins
steps: Check the installed version
Ubuntu, Debian
RHEL, Rocky, Alma, Amazon Linux
openssh.note: Distribution packages often carry fixes under an older version number. Check the distribution's security notice to see whether your package has the fix.

linux.label: Linux
steps: Check the kernel version
Ubuntu, Debian
RHEL, Rocky, Alma, Amazon Linux
A new kernel takes effect only after a reboot
linux.note: Each distribution ships the fixed kernel at its own pace. Check your distribution's security notice to see whether this flaw is fixed.
